notes: Asking for the shake to go now steadies the clip, whichever way you say it. “Smooth the shakiness out” worked, but “smooth the jitter out”, “take the shake out of it” and “get the wobble out” quietly started a full upscale instead — minutes of work on something you had not asked for. Every ordinary way of saying it now reaches the stabiliser: take it out, get it out, smooth it out or iron it out, and shake, shakiness, wobble or jitter. Forty-eight phrasings were checked, not the one that was reported.
